basic_details.job_title: IWST Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 MTS, LDC, Technical Assistant Posts
basic_details.post_name: Technical Assistant (Field/Lab), Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)
basic_details.short_information: ICFRE-Institute of Wood Science and Technology (IWST), Bengaluru, Karnataka, has invited applications for 10 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 1-5/2026-27/IWST/Estt./2711. The posts include Technical Assistant (Field/Lab), Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Multi Tasking Staff (MTS). Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

application_fee.general_fee: Rs. 1000 (Rs. 400 application fee + Rs. 600 processing fee)
application_fee.sc_fee: Rs. 600 processing fee only (fee exempted for categories as applicable)
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft from any nationalized bank in favour of 'Director, Institute of Wood Science and Technology' payable at Bengaluru.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor degree in Science (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics), 12th class, 10th Standard pass

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Bachelor degree in Science (with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) from a recognized university. Age limit: Not below 21 years or exceeding 30 years. Pay: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level - 5. Qualification required: 12th class certificate from recognized board; A typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi on manual typewriter OR typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer. Age limit: Not below 18 years or exceeding 27 years. Pay: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level - 2. Qualification required: 10th Standard pass certificate from recognized board/school. Experience required: 3 years or more experience in relevant trade (Desirable). Age limit: Not below 18 years or exceeding 27 years. Pay: 7th CPC Pay Mat

salary_details.pay_scale: Depends on the post (see the table below)

exam_pattern.details: 1/3rd mark will be deducted for each incorrect / wrong answer.

content_sections.heading: How Will IWST Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Examination Typewriting Test (for LDC) Document Verification Technical Assistant: Written examination comprising General Awareness & Reasoning, English & General Science, Arithmetic, Relevant Subject (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics). Lower Division Clerk: Written exam (General English, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness and Mental Ability & Reasoning) and Typewriting Test.

content_sections.heading: IWST Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: 1/3rd mark will be deducted for each incorrect / wrong answer.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly signed and completed application form Demand Draft for application fee Self-attested copy of age proof (10th Std certificate, Aadhar Card, Date of Birth/Transfer Certificate) Self-attested copy of educational qualifications and mark sheets Recent Passport Size photographs with name and post written on the back (5 nos) OBC/ST/PH certificates if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IWST Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit applications to The Director, ICFRE-Institute of Wood Science & Technology, 18th Cross, Malleswaram, Bengaluru-560003. Send by speed post, courier or in person. Indicate the post applied for and category clearly on top of the envelope in capital letters. Make sure it reaches by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IWST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IWST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 1 Technical Assistant (Field/Lab), 3 Lower Division Clerk (LDC), 6 Multi Tasking Staff (MTS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IWST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (PDF pages 9-32) and send it to The Director, ICFRE-Institute of Wood Science & Technology, 18th Cross, Malleswaram, Bengaluru-560003, by speed post or by courier or in person, to reach by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/OBC: Rs. 1000 (Rs. 400 application fee + Rs. 600 processing fee). Female / PwD / SC / ST: Rs. 600 processing fee only (fee exempted for categories as applicable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Technical Assistant (Field/Lab): not below 21 years or exceeding 30 years; Lower Division Clerk (LDC): not below 18 years or exceeding 27 years; Multi Tasking Staff (MTS): not below 18 years or exceeding 27 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level - 5 for Technical Assistant (Field/Lab), 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level - 2 for Lower Division Clerk (LDC), 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level - 1 for Multi Tasking Staff (MTS).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor degree in Science (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics), 12th class, 10th Standard pass. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Citizens are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Examination. Typewriting Test (for LDC). Document Verification. Technical Assistant: Written examination comprising General Awareness & Reasoning, English & General Science, Arithmetic, Relevant Subject (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All posts are temporary in nature. Probationary period as per rules.
